title: Metric definitions
purpose: Support detailed questions without slowing the main deck.
takeaway: The evaluation metrics describe bounded prediction and extraction tasks, not end-to-end citation uplift.

bullets: Required-anchor retention: eligible required anchors preserved by an extractor.
Unwanted-anchor leakage: eligible unwanted anchors preserved by an extractor.
ROC-AUC: how often a sampled top record ranks above a sampled bottom record.
Within-host AUC: the same ranking comparison averaged separately across websites.
